title: What Another Payer Is Taken to Have Met on a Dental, Vision or Hearing Cost
content:
Where a recovery is worked out on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card, what another payer has met is read from the member's other Ridgecrest records rather than from the card.

**The rule.** What another payer has met is what a dental, vision and hearing rider paid on the claims it settled in that stretch, where the member holds such a rider that is in force and its own record shows it paid on a claim settled in that stretch; it is the yearly dental allowance the member's medical plan tier carries, where the member holds no such rider in force and that medical plan tier carries such an allowance; and it is nothing in every other case.

**Where each figure is found.**

| The member's records show | What another payer has met |
|---|---|
| a rider of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders covering dental, vision and hearing, in force, whose own settled claims in the stretch looked at show an amount the rider paid | the total the rider paid on the claims it settled in that stretch |
| no such rider in force, and a plan of the Medicare Advantage Health Plans whose tier carries a yearly dental allowance | the yearly dental allowance that medical plan tier carries |
| neither | nothing |

The rider's settled claims are read from the rider's own claim records — the claims whose standing is paid, taken by the day the claim was processed, with the amount the rider paid on each. The yearly dental allowance is a figure of the medical plan tier itself, not of the card.

**Basis Q&A, on hypothetical records.** A member holds a dental rider in force whose settled claims in the stretch show 90.00 USD and 60.00 USD paid by the rider: what another payer has met is 150.00 USD. A member holds a rider in force but it settled no claim in the stretch and paid nothing: the first row is not satisfied; the member holds a rider in force, so the second row is not satisfied either, and what another payer has met is nothing. A member holds no rider at all and a medical plan whose tier carries a yearly dental allowance of 500.00 USD: what another payer has met is 500.00 USD.
